findings.title: September Nuclei baseline value is not supported by the upstream stable release
findings.evidence: Baseline says 3.16.1+, while the official GitHub latest stable release is v3.11.1 (2026-08-08).
findings.impact: A future 3.16 to 3.x comparison could hide a real compatibility change or produce a false rollback.
findings.action: During 2026-12-14 D1, record 3.11.1 unless a more authoritative upstream source for 3.16.1 is produced.

findings.title: Baseline does not explicitly distinguish upstream version from Kali package version
findings.evidence: Upstream Burp is 2026.11.2 while the Kali tracker still lists 2026.7; upstream Wireshark is 4.6.10 while Kali lists 4.6.9; upstream Docker Engine is 29.10.1 while Kali docker.io lists 27.5.1.
findings.impact: Running the local checker against a Kali host can report apparent drift that is actually distribution lag.
findings.action: The December baseline should add an explicit source dimension: upstream-stable versus kali-rolling.

findings.title: check-tool-versions.py cannot encode the Tuesday 10-tool rotation or authoritative sources
findings.evidence: The script parses all Top-N rows and probes local apt/binary state; it has no source manifest or rotation selector.
findings.impact: The cadence remains manually sourced and non-reproducible from one command.
findings.action: Backlog: add --tools and a source-map mode without weakening the existing local Kali-host check.
